# TeeVents

> All-in-one golf tournament management software for charity, corporate, and nonprofit golf tournaments. Branded event sites, online registration, live scoring, sponsors, pairings, and automated payments via Stripe Connect.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of the TeeVents platform.
- [Plans & Pricing](/plans): Base ($0) and Pro ($399 per tournament) plans.
- [Features](/features): Full list of platform features.
- [Services](/services): White-glove tournament consulting and management services.
- [About](/about): About TeeVents and the team.
- [Nonprofits](/nonprofits): Tools for 501(c)(3) charity golf tournaments.
- [Contact](/contact): How to reach the TeeVents team.
- [FAQ](/faq): Frequently asked questions about pricing, payouts, and support.
- [Book a Demo](/book): Schedule a 30-minute live demo.
- [Get Started](/get-started): Create an organizer account.
- [Reviews](/reviews): Customer reviews and testimonials.
